verdict.rationale: Alacritty's TOML config lets users set colors as hex values, and it can import extra config files with live reload, so a color scheme can be defined and applied. Nothing in the evidence shows built-in theme selection or any automatic light/dark switching. Missing for 10: documented color-scheme/theme sections or a named theme mechanism, automatic light/dark mode switching, independent or hands-on corroboration of theming.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can apply color schemes and themes, including automatic light/dark mode switching

citations.quote: Colors are specified using their hexadecimal values with a # prefix: #RRGGBB.
Imports are loaded in order, skipping all missing files, with the importing file being loaded last.
